memory_candidates: Mathlib has no formalization of intuitionistic Kripke semantics, tableau calculi, or fuel/fixpoint-sufficiency measures -- Heyting algebras exist but connect to nothing Kripke- or tableau-shaped. Do not budget research time searching for a Mathlib shortcut on these.

A lemma being locally sorry-free does not mean it is usable: applyPersistenceFixpoint_genuine_of_count_le_fuel is sorry-free but dead code, and its hb/hfuel hypotheses require invariant plumbing that does not exist in the caller's signature. Check call sites, not just sorry-freeness, when assessing whether a landed lemma closes a gap.

When two docstrings in one file contradict each other about whether a gap is blocked, git blame settles it: the later commit wins, and the commit that landed the enabling code is the authoritative one.
